brief:
Syria formally told the United Nations that ongoing Israeli military operations targeting its territory undermine attempts to achieve regional stability and risk plunging the area into deeper conflict, Shehab Wire reported. The Syrian complaint encompassed repeated Israeli airstrikes, ground incursions, and alleged abduction operations conducted across Syrian soil.

The statement followed recent Israeli airstrikes that struck Abu al-Duhur airport. Syrian officials characterized the pattern of Israeli military activity as an obstacle to broader efforts aimed at establishing peace and reducing tensions across the region. The complaint represents Syria's latest formal objection to what it describes as repeated violations of its sovereignty.

title: Syria tells UN Israel's attacks obstruct regional stability efforts
